connector.name: MCP by the13f.com
connector.registryDescription: Institutional 13F intelligence: 8,600+ managers, holdings, peer search, sector flows.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package the13f-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.the13f, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: THE13F_API_KEY
env.description: Free pf13f_ key from https://the13f.com/developers/. 100 calls/day, no credit card. Without it, every tool returns a structured free-signup-required response with the signup URL.

env.name: THE13F_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override API base URL. Defaults to https://api.the13f.com. Used for local development against a running copy of the13f's gui_server.

env.name: THE13F_MCP_TIMEOUT
env.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds. Minimum 5.
